fusions.name: Start the Stampede
fusions.desc: A spooked rush that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Midnight Tipping
fusions.desc: A shove from the blind side that deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 1.5 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Behind the Herd
fusions.desc: Slips you 2 tiles from where you stood and reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds. While it lasts, an escort fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Trot
fusions.desc: You move 6% faster, and your physical resistance rises by 8%.
